scenario: Mapped GitHub repository contains the requested file
expected: Read local bytes without a network call.

scenario: Mapped GitHub repository lacks the requested file
expected: ARROW_NOT_FOUND and exit 1; no remote fallback.

scenario: Missing default config; missing explicit config; empty config; malformed config
expected: No mappings; exit 2; no mappings; exit 2 respectively.

scenario: Invalid source or unsupported ftp scheme
expected: ARROW_USAGE and exit 2.

scenario: Destination exists without --force or parent is unwritable
expected: Exit 1 with ARROW_EXISTS or ARROW_PERMISSION; preserve existing file.

scenario: Network failure or rate limiting while enumerating
expected: Exit 1; diagnostic code on stderr; no partial stdout.

scenario: File operand; empty directory; unmatched glob; invalid glob
expected: Single file; zero results; zero results; exit 2 respectively.

scenario: Recursive remote tree is truncated
expected: Complete traversal or ARROW_INCOMPLETE with exit 1.

scenario: Invalid owner; valid owner without repositories; no topic matches; no file matches
expected: Exit 1; empty success; empty success; empty success respectively.

scenario: Discovery operand refers to a directory
expected: Do not report a file match.

scenario: Authenticated accessible private repository
expected: Read using existing gh credentials; never request arrow-specific credentials.

scenario: Source traversal or symlink escaping mapped root
expected: Reject access; never read outside the root.

scenario: Repeated listing over unchanged fixtures
expected: Identical sorted text and JSON outputs.

scenario: Failed transfer during cp --force; destination is a symlink; source and destination are the same file
expected: Exit 1; preserve existing bytes and remove temporary files.

scenario: Local source is a FIFO or a symlink component; a path is replaced by an escaping symlink during open
expected: Reject without blocking or reading outside the mapped root.

scenario: Remote path is a symlink or submodule
expected: Reject cat/cp sources; omit listing and discovery matches.

scenario: A user owns an accessible private repository containing the requested file
expected: Include the match through authenticated repository enumeration.

scenario: Listing path contains a newline or terminal escape character
expected: Escape controls in text; preserve the path value in valid JSON.

scenario: Version requested with an absent explicit config and no network access
expected: Exit 0 with embedded project version; do not read runtime config or credentials.

scenario: Global home CUE config and a checkout containing .gh-arrow
expected: Use only the home mappings; ignore checkout configuration. Explicit --config selects only its named file.

scenario: CUE imports; unknown fields; incomplete values; duplicate mappings; nonabsolute roots
expected: Exit 2 without exposing configuration values or absolute file paths in diagnostics.

scenario: Sync missing binary and text files then change a destination and audit again
expected: Dry-run/status/check preserve destinations; check exits 3 for drift; apply preserves exact bytes; subsequent check exits 0; diff runs local to upstream.

scenario: A later upstream file fails during sync planning
expected: Exit 1 with no success output; preserve all destinations; mapped source never falls back remotely.

scenario: Sync manifest has traversal absolute duplicate or overlapping destinations unknown ref wildcard source imports or self-overwrite
expected: Exit 2 before fetching or changing files.

scenario: Sync source is a directory or destination has symlink components or missing parent
expected: Exit 1 without changing destinations or creating directories.

scenario: Several sync sources share one remote repository while its default branch moves
expected: Resolve the repository once and use the same commit for all files; mapped sources use current working-tree bytes.
